records.detail: Rasuwa Flood Rescue Portal | OPMCM Rasuwa Flood Rescue Portal — Government of Nepal (OPMCM) Official portal for the 2026 Bhote Koshi–Trishuli flash flood in Rasuwa, Nepal: search for missing persons, request or offer help, find emergency contacts, and read the official government rescue & relief status.

The search and rescue teams including security personnel, provincial and local governments, medical and emergency responders are continuously working together in the affected areas of Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading and Chitwan Districts to locate, search, rescue and assist them who have been affected and need urgent help.

Despite massive destruction and difficulties created by the Bhote Koshi River floods in areas of Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading and Chitwan, the other part of Nepal is normal as earlier and open for foreigners/travellers/tourists.
From Tamure in Rasuwa, 123 people were airlifted, including 94 Nepalis and 29 foreigners.
NRCS Response Initial Rapid Assessment (IRA orientation 15 volunteers in Nuwakot oriented on IRA and have been mobilized for the data collection in the affected areas).

Restoring Family Link (RFL) Services: Help desk established at Nuwakot supporting them to connect with their relatives th rough phone call 25 Dead body bag handed over to Kalimati Police 75 Dead bod y bag dispatched to Chitwan from Birgunj warehouse 150 dead body bag handed over to APF hospital 200 dead body bag handed over to HEOC Ready to eat food (RTEFs ) distributed to 750 people.
The flood rapidly impacted the Timure, Rasuwagadhi, and Syabrubesi areas, causing significant damage to settlements, markets, police infrastructure, roads, and hydropower facilities.
From Tamure in Rasuwa, 123 people were airlifted, including 94 Nepalis and 29 foreigners.

Shuttle flights are being operated continuously in Dhunche, Trishuli, Timure, Syafrubesi, and other areas by mobilizing 16 helicopters from the Nepal Army and the private sector combined.
Rasuwa, the district ripped by the catastrophic flash flood, has been reconnected to the road network.
So far, the electricity service has been restored in about 90 percent of the areas of Nuwakot, while Dhunche will have electricity soon.
